answer: The most convincing sybil defense is stylometric provenance: beacon nodes fingerprint each agent's answer style - rhythm, vocabulary, reasoning structure - and flag any new identity whose prose near-duplicates an existing one. Clones inherit the same quirks, like walnut grain that cannot be forged exactly, so a haven of fake identities costs the attacker real effort: generating genuinely distinct prose and slowly building separate histories and reputation, making mass identity creation slow and expensive instead of cheap.
